ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The basic building block in image1 is composed of 5 identical small rectangles, and can be regarded as a grid of 3 columns and 2 rows, with all 3 in the upper row present, 1 each on the left and right of the lower row, and 1 missing in the middle. image2 is a vertical H shape, in which a total of 10 small rectangles can be counted. image3 has 5 in the upper row, and 1 each in columns 1, 3, and 5 in the lower row, for a total of 8 small rectangles. image4 is a staggered three-row shape: 3 in the upper row, 4 in the middle row, and 3 in the lower row, for a total of 10. image5 is an outer-frame shape of 3 columns and 4 rows, with a vertical hollow in the middle, for a total of 10 small rectangles. image6 is a vertical I shape: 4 on top, 2 in the middle, and 4 below, for a total of 10 small rectangles. Reasoning: Two basic building blocks together must use 5+5=10 small rectangles, so any pattern that is not 10 small rectangles cannot be formed from two building blocks. image3 has only 8, so it cannot be formed. The remaining patterns all have 10, then check whether they can be divided into two 5-cell building blocks with the same shape as image1: image2 can be divided into an upper and a lower U-shaped building block; image4 can be divided into two staggered U-shaped building blocks; image5 can be divided into an upper half and a lower half two building blocks around the middle hollow; image6 can be divided into left and right two rotated building blocks. Therefore the feasible patterns are image2, image4, image5, and image6, for a total of 4.

raw_record.question_text: A building block is made up of five identical rectangles. How many of the patterns shown below can be made with two such building blocks without overlap?

method.method_draft: First read the picture: image1 is the building block, consisting of 5 identical rectangles arranged like a 3-by-2 grid with the lower middle rectangle missing. Then inspect each proposed pattern in images2–6 as a grid of the same small rectangles. Since two blocks must use exactly 10 rectangles, immediately reject any pattern whose visible area is not 10 rectangles; image3 has only 8 rectangles, so it cannot be made. For the remaining patterns, verify by drawing a dividing line or mentally coloring 5 rectangles for each copy of the block: image2 splits into a top U-shaped copy and a bottom U-shaped copy; image4 splits into two offset U-shaped copies; image5 splits into the top half and bottom half around the hole; image6 splits into left and right rotated copies. Thus exactly 4 patterns can be made.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：image1 中的基本积木由 5 个相同小长方形组成，可看成 3 列、2 行的格子，上排 3 个都有，下排左、右各 1 个，中间缺 1 个。image2 是一个竖向的 H 形，共可数出 10 个小长方形。image3 上排有 5 个，下排在第 1、3、5 列各有 1 个，共 8 个小长方形。image4 是错位的三行形状：上排 3 个，中排 4 个，下排 3 个，共 10 个。image5 是 3 列、4 行的外框形，中间有竖向空洞，共 10 个小长方形。image6 是竖向 I 形：上面 4 个，中间 2 个，下面 4 个，共 10 个小长方形。

推理：两个基本积木一共必须使用 5+5=10 个小长方形，所以任何不是 10 个小长方形的图案都不能由两个积木组成。image3 只有 8 个，因此不能组成。其余图案都有 10 个，再检查能否分成两个与 image1 同形的 5 格积木：image2 可以分成上、下两个 U 形积木；image4 可以分成两个错位的 U 形积木；image5 可以分成围绕中间空洞的上半和下半两个积木；image6 可以分成左、右两个旋转后的积木。因此可行的图案有 image2、image4、image5、image6，共 4 个。
